name: stateTime
meaning: g_gameTime at hide/respawn transitions (10 s wait, 1 s wobble). Collides with ScnMobile.csv's 0x7c/0x7e slopeLimit rows, which are Sheep-specific

name: eatTime
meaning: g_dt accumulated while a sheep sends msg 1; >=0x3000 (3 s) -> eaten. Cumulative across sheep and visits; cleared only by Consume/Reset/Init

name: liftBlockMs
meaning: ms since msg 0x79 (Wooden Lift); liftBlocked cleared after 1000

name: homePos
meaning: respawn/restart position; = pos at Init and at checkpoint msg 9 arg 1

name: squashed
meaning: bit 0 of the flag byte +0x8f, a one-bit field: squashed model (ALAITU02) currently swapped in

name: mainModel
meaning: base model entry filled by ScnObject_InitWithAltModels in Salad_Create

name: squashedModel
meaning: alternate model WAR_IDO_ALAITU02 (id list 0x77) shown in state 3

name: liftBlocked
meaning: set by msg 0x79 from the Wooden Lift; while set, sheep get 0 from msg 2 (not attracted)
